title: A day to explore the new dimensions of perfumery
summary: Artificial intelligence, neuroscience, groundbreaking discovery techniques, hybridization, dupes, personalization… In just a few years, perfumery has become one of the most dynamic category of the beauty industry. To make sense of these transformations and anticipate what lies ahead, the Fragrance Innovation Summit returns to Paris on November 25 for a full day of presentations from international experts and discussions exploring the forces shaping the future of fragrance.
